subject: english
question:
**Direction: Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

Famous or well-known for a negative reason
solution:
The correct answer is **"Notorious."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Notorious"** means famous or well-known for a negative reason. (बदनामी, कुख्‍याति)

 
 
• **Example**: *Al Capone was a **notorious**__ gangster in the 1920s.*
 
 
 
• It is derived from the Latin word
